house.description: Sale of foods containing FD&C Yellow No. 5 or 6 to schools prohibited.

House.text: Introduction and first reading, referred to Commerce Finance and Policy

latest_action.text: Introduction and first reading, referred to Commerce Finance and Policy

bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to consumer protection; prohibiting the sale of foods containing FD&C Yellow No. 5 or 6 to schools; proposing coding for new law in Minnesota Statutes, chapter 325F.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1.

[+[325F.079] PRODUCTS CONTAINING FD&C YELLOW NO. 5 OR 6. +]

[+(a) A person is prohibited from knowingly selling, offering to sell, distributing, or offering for use to a school, as defined in section 120A.22, subdivision 4, foods that contain FD&C Yellow No. 5 or 6. +]

[+(b) This section does not apply to home schools. +]

[+EFFECTIVE DATE.+]

[+This section is effective January 1, 2027. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to consumer protection; prohibiting the sale of foods containing FD&C Yellow No. 5 or 6 to schools; proposing coding for new law in Minnesota Statutes, chapter 325F.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1.

[325F.079] PRODUCTS CONTAINING FD&C YELLOW NO. 5 OR 6.

(a) A person is prohibited from knowingly selling, offering to sell, distributing, or offering for use to a school, as defined in section 120A.22, subdivision 4, foods that contain FD&C Yellow No. 5 or 6.

(b) This section does not apply to home schools.

EFFECTIVE DATE.

This section is effective January 1, 2027.
